scenario_name: Language switch mid-conversation — Spanish to English
expected_behavior: First turn: responds in Spanish about restaurants. Second turn: switches to English naturally without commenting on the language change. Provides steakhouse information in English.
expected_behavioral_quality: Follows the guest's language switch naturally. When guest starts in Spanish then switches to English, agent follows and responds in English. No awkward language mixing or commenting on the switch.

turns.user_message: Hola, me gustaria saber sobre los restaurantes
turns.agent_response:
Mohegan Sun ofrece más de 40 opciones que van desde cenas de lujo hasta bocados rápidos de 24 horas. 

Si buscas una experiencia italiana contemporánea con pastas hechas en casa, te sugiero **Ballo Italian Restaurant** en Casino of the Sky; es uno de nuestros lugares más destacados por su ambiente elegante. Por otro lado, si prefieres algo más animado y casual, **SolToro** en Casino of the Earth tiene excelentes tacos y una selección de tequilas de primera clase.

Un detalle de conocedor: si te da hambre tarde en la noche, **Lantern Bar & Grill** está abierto las 24 horas y es el lugar ideal para una comida completa sin importar la hora.

¿Tienes alguna preferencia de comida en particular o vienes a celebrar alguna ocasión especial?

turns.user_message: Actually, can you tell me about the steakhouse in English?
turns.agent_response:
The wood-fired aroma hits you the moment you walk into Michael Jordan's Steak House in the Casino of the Sky. It is our premier destination for USDA Prime steaks and fresh seafood, served in an elegant room filled with tasteful sports memorabilia. 

They are open tonight until 10:00 PM, and as it is a high-end $$$$ venue, business casual attire is the recommended dress code. Since it is a Saturday night, securing a reservation is your best bet for a table. One insider tip: their wine list is incredibly deep, so do not hesitate to ask for a pairing recommendation to go with your steak.

After your meal, novelle is right nearby in the Casino of the Sky and is a great place to enjoy a craft cocktail and some music to keep the night going.

Are you planning to join us for a special celebration tonight, or just a great Saturday dinner?
